entries.title: Column Default Values & Reliability Fixes
entries.summary: Set default values (literal or SQL expression) on backend app table columns, an update-available sidebar banner, and fixes for dashboard login, app users listing, and auth API consistency.

items.description: Column default value in the backend app schema builder — literal defaults for integer/bigint/numeric, a true/false picker for boolean, and gen_random_uuid()/now() SQL expressions for uuid/timestamptz, validated server-side against a strict allowlist before reaching the generated DDL
Update notifications — sidebar banner alerts when a new Zeep Orbit release is available on GitHub, linking to the release page
Dashboard Google login failing behind multiple replicas — OAuth state was kept in an in-memory map per process; now signed stateless (HMAC-SHA256)
GitHub App installation callback had the same in-memory state issue as Google login — fixed the same way
/apps/{id}/users always returned an empty list when email auth was enabled, due to an incorrect schema name lookup
PATCH /{app}/auth/me returned 405 despite being documented — route was registered as PUT
Auth provider "allowed domains" field couldn't be cleared once set
Google login button and brand theme flashed incorrectly on first paint of the login screen
App token refresh endpoint was missing from the per-app Swagger docs

entries.title: App Tokens & Security Fixes
entries.summary: JWT token management for apps without email auth, plus multiple security fixes found during code review.

items.description: App Tokens — full JWT token management for apps without email/password auth: create tokens with expiration (7d/30d/365d/never), one-time JWT reveal, list with status badges, revoke individually
Regenerate Secret — rotate JWT secret with 2-step confirmation, revokes all existing tokens for the app
Reveal Secret — view the current JWT secret (audit-logged)
Token Refresh endpoint — POST /{app}/auth/token/refresh exchanges a valid app token for a new one with same jti, extending expiration by original duration
JWTMiddleware validates revocation/expiry per-request via in-memory jti cache (30s TTL) with fire-and-forget last_used_at touch
New zeep_system.app_tokens table with full CRUD and cascade delete
IDOR fix — RegenerateAppSecret now enforces app ownership check (previously any authenticated dashboard user could rotate any app's JWT secret)
Dead revocation check fix — JWTMiddleware had a nil keyFunc causing the entire DB revocation check to silently never run. Revoked tokens stayed valid until natural expiry
Nil pointer fix — CreateAppToken panicked on registry cache miss. Now reads JWT secret from the already-loaded app row
Stale revocation window fix — JTI cache now invalidated immediately on revoke/regenerate (previously gave revoked tokens up to 30s of extra validity)
Predictable JTI fallback fix — randomJTI now returns an error instead of a fixed deterministic ID when crypto/rand.Read fails
Missing rate limit — token refresh endpoint now rate-limited like register and login

entries.title: Brand Config Persistence Fix
entries.summary: Fixed company name and theme resetting on restart. Removed logo upload feature.

items.description: Company name and theme no longer reset to defaults on restart — startup seeding now uses dedicated SeedBrandConfig with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING instead of overwriting saved values
ProvisionZeepSystem wraps all DDL in a single transaction with pg_advisory_xact_lock for safe concurrent pod startup
Logo upload removed — dashboard and login page use the default Zeep Orbit logo

entries.title: Google OAuth Fix & API Docs Branding

items.description: Google OAuth now works with multiple replicas — state param replaced with stateless HMAC-SHA256 signed token, eliminating the need for shared in-memory state or sticky sessions
API docs now show neutral 'API Documentation' title instead of hardcoded 'zeep-orbit API'
Login page and app subtitle copy updated for clarity

Authentication — email/password per app with register, login, refresh, logout; Google OAuth for dashboard and per-app; Row-Level Security
REST API — full CRUD per table with filtering, sorting, pagination; auto-generated OpenAPI/Swagger UI per app
CLI — zeep serve, zeep apply, zeep list, zeep status
Multi-stage Docker image (< 20MB, multi-arch: amd64 + arm64)
Production-grade Helm chart (HPA, PDB, Ingress, ServiceMonitor, IRSA)
